fabrication_suspected.description: True if eval results, fallback output, sources, or retrieval dates look invented or inconsistent with the repository.

personal_data.description: True if the repository contains personal data about individuals without documented permission.

needs_credentials.description: True if the seed prompt cannot produce a meaningful result without an API key, MCP server, or login.

notes.description: One or two sentences of evidence for any true flag; empty otherwise.

one_liner.description: What this skill does for whom, in one sentence, for the jury.

strongest.description: The single strongest aspect, one sentence with a file path.

weakest.description: The single weakest aspect, one sentence with a file path.

rationale.description: One sentence citing the file or line that justifies the score.
